newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due week Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due week Nov 25.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Nov 25 include:
28/11 Fortis in ecu Nine M PFT 549.2 526-561 469.0

Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated. This forecast includes two estimates for Fortis, one in guilders for Fortis Amev and one in ecus for Fortis.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, ING Barings, IRIS, Generale Bank, Kempen & Co, NIBStrating, Labouchere, and Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
